summary.intent: Debug BYO-IPFS register-cid 400 errors on staging by fixing the load test workload and underlying API issues. Also wire CTR encryption for media uploads in the SDK uploadFile path.
summary.outcome: Fixed two root causes: missing PATCH /vault/byo-status endpoint (setByoStatus was dead code with no controller) and incorrect ipns-publish payload in load test. Also completed the CTR encryption feature (PR #399) and resolved all PR review comments including centralizing MIME type lists into sdk-core.

repo: setByoStatus() existed as a VaultService method but had no controller endpoint — BYO mode could never be toggled via API, making register-cid always return 403

The load test byo-file-workload sent { ipnsName, cid } to ipns-publish but PublishIpnsEntryDto requires { ipnsName, record, metadataCid } — requires a real signed IPNS record via createAndPublishIpnsRecord

STREAMING_MIME_TYPES and CTR_SIZE_THRESHOLD were duplicated between packages/sdk/src/client.ts and apps/web/src/services/streaming-crypto.service.ts — centralized into packages/sdk-core/src/encryption-mode.ts
The API openapi.json spec lives at packages/api-client/openapi.json, not apps/api/openapi.json — manual generation scripts must target the correct path
All API spec files (*.spec.ts) consistently use jest.Mocked<Partial<T>> pattern for mock services, which loses mock method types after module.get() calls — must reassign from the mock object directly
Todos moved to done/ can leave stale pending/ copies when a feature branch is merged to a base branch that itself gets merged to main — both copies can appear in main simultaneously
FLAC files (audio/flac) were missing from the streaming MIME type allowlist in both SDK and web app

code.finding: New centralized module for selectEncryptionMode(mimeType, size) and normalizeEncryptionMode() — single source of truth for CTR vs GCM selection logic
uploadFile() now accepts optional encryptionMode param; uses encryptAesCtr + generateCtrIv when 'CTR', falls back to GCM for invalid/missing values via normalizeEncryptionMode
uploadFile() now calls selectEncryptionMode(mimeType, size) from sdk-core before calling sdkCore.uploadFile() — CTR mode activates for video/audio files >256KB
New PATCH /vault/byo-status endpoint added using ByoStatusDto — wires the previously dead setByoStatus() service method
mockVaultService was missing setByoStatus — new tests cover enable, disable, and propagated errors for the byo-status endpoint
createByoClientPool now calls PATCH /vault/byo-status after account creation to enable BYO mode
ipns-publish step replaced with createAndPublishIpnsRecord from sdk-core to produce valid signed IPNS records instead of sending wrong fields
mockRequest typed as RequestWithUser required explicit import and cast — previously used Request & { user: ... } which is not assignable

workflow: When centralizing shared logic, the web app's File-based API (selectEncryptionMode(file: File)) can be replaced with a thin wrapper delegating to the shared (mimeType, size) signature
Running pnpm typecheck on dependent packages after adding exports requires rebuilding the source package first so compiled types are available
GitHub Copilot review comments on new files reliably flag: (1) missing input validation, (2) duplicated constants, (3) missing unit tests — worth anticipating these proactively
GraphQL GitHub API can timeout while REST API remains available — falling back to REST /pulls/{pr}/comments is a reliable workaround for fetching review threads
When API client needs regeneration, the running API server must be the latest build — regenerating against a stale server produces stale types
Fixing jest.Mocked<Partial<T>> type errors: use the mock object directly rather than module.get() to preserve mock method types without non-null assertions

friction: GitHub GraphQL API timed out multiple times during PR review thread resolution — had to fall back to REST API
Manual OpenAPI generation script wrote to wrong path (apps/api/openapi.json instead of packages/api-client/openapi.json), creating a 3889-line accidental file in the PR diff
Pre-existing API test errors in 9 files required fixing before typecheck was clean — systemic jest.Mocked<Partial<T>> pattern used across all API specs loses mock method types after module.get()
sdk-core build output needed to be rebuilt before SDK typecheck would pass — stale compiled types caused false type errors
The todo for the completed SDK GCM/CTR work appeared in both pending/ and done/ after the merge from the feature branch, requiring manual cleanup
API client regeneration requires the running API server to serve the new build — the dev server was running the old build without the new endpoint
open_items: integration.test.ts in packages/sdk fails because it hits a real API endpoint — pre-existing issue not related to this work, needs investigation
BYO-IPFS load test baselines on staging (todo #11) still need to be run after these fixes land — the 400/403 errors were blocking meaningful baseline data
The streaming-playback E2E test was previously skipped (test.skip) — now unskipped and passing locally, but CI coverage of this test path should be monitored
PATCH /vault/byo-status endpoint is now wired but there is no integration test covering the full BYO flow (enable BYO → upload → register-cid → ipns-publish)

Remaining pending todos: Web Worker file encryption offload, ERC-1271 contract wallet auth, CRDT-based IPNS inbox research, async search index, alternative MFA factors, mock-ipns-routing removal investigation
